'''John Sarnecki''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 7 from Munster, In. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He played the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]].<ref name="list-53912" /> His profile was a joke bio about being cryogenically frozen until the prequels and plotting to steal Kendrick Summers's "Mojo" to become Gold Leader.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.

== Anagrams ==

* [[Corporal Kensaric]] — John Sarnecki, Gold 7

== King of Corellia ==

Sarnecki introduced Indiana and Illinois to the King of Corellia tournament. It went on hiatus after he retired from the squadron, and returned on 2 September (Labor Day weekend) in Carmel, Indiana.<ref name="geo2001">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Original GeoCities home], 13 May 2001 (Wayback)</ref>
